resources.string: The train left at six, and I let it. I stood on the platform with two tickets in my pocket, watching the lights get smaller, and for the first time in years I didn\'t feel late for anything.
I walked home the long way. The bakery was just opening, the street still wet from the night. Some letters are never sent. Some are only written so you can finally put the pen down.
